displayedInputs.question:
Each of the following four large congruent squares is subdivided into combinations of congruent triangles or rectangles and is partially shaded. What percent of the total area is partially shaded?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

Carmen takes a long bike ride on a hilly highway. The graph indicates the miles traveled during the time of her ride. What is Carmen’s average speed for her entire ride in miles per hour?

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

The graph shows the number of minutes studied by both Asha (left bar) and Sasha (right bar) in one week. On the average, how many more minutes per day did Sasha study than Asha?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

Two congruent squares, \(ABCD\) and \(PQRS,\) have side length \(15.\) They overlap to form the \(15\) by \(25\) rectangle \(AQRD\) shown. What percent of the area of rectangle \(AQRD\) is shaded?

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

How many rectangles are in this figure?

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

Quadrilateral \(ABCD\) is a trapezoid, \(AD = 15,\) \(AB = 50,\) \(BC = 20,\) and the altitude is \(12.\) What is the area of the trapezoid?

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

A circle with radius \(1\) is inscribed in a square and circumscribed about another square as shown. Which fraction is closest to the ratio of the circle’s shaded area to the shaded area between the two squares?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

Three unit squares and two line segments connecting two pairs of vertices are shown. What is the area of \(\triangle ABC?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
